slices.focus: Ariana runs the first structured neighborhood listening afternoon, turning public feedback into archive improvements
slices.summary: Ariana organizes a neighborhood listening afternoon at the center with cleaned clips, program notes, and a sign-in sheet asking attendees to identify names, corners, and businesses. The event produces corrections, new leads, and a repeatable public programming model.
open_loops: Writing a short internal memo documenting what worked and what feedback came back
Flagging top 2-3 leads for immediate outreach while social momentum is warm
Designing a repeatable template with optional clip cards alongside the sign-in sheet
decisions: Ariana expanded the Tremé Heritage Center oral-history program into public use by running structured neighborhood listen
